phase1_leaf_result.part89_scope: Official GitHub immutable-release/tag witness classification plus own clean Part88 continuation.
phase1_leaf_result.new_positive_evidence: Immutable releases provider-lock the associated tag and preserve same-tag-name non-reuse after immutable release deletion and repository resurrection under the same name.
phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: The bounded official documentation does not expose a non-mutating way for a stateless same-principal client to reconstruct the maximum deleted immutable generation after both the local newest pointer and original release/repository objects are gone.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: Provider-enforced non-mutating discovery of the maximum immutable-release/tag anti-reuse generation across repository delete/recreate, or an equivalent independently discoverable monotonic floor.

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Bounded official-documentation classification only; anti-reuse is established for immutable tag names, but maximum-generation reconstructibility and universal zero-finite-quota entitlement are not established.
